notes.title: Update 1.2 notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

The team have once again been working hard to resolve a major issue some of you were experiencing. Please see the notes from the develoepers below for more information:

AMD CPU issue fix has been implemented, which appears to fix the problem on our end. However, we'd appriciate if you let us know if you are still experiencing issues after this update.
Console has been implemented that allows unlocking of fps. Please use the tilde key to access. You will need to turn VSYNC off and then use t.maxfps 120 to set the max to 120.
NOTE: UE4 has a max FPS cap of 120 in the engine, so you can't get higher. We are investigating a way to unlock this.



Again we'd like to thank you for being patient and the continued support of The Turing Test!


-Amy

notes.title: Update 1.0 notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

The team have fixed some of the initial bugs in the game, please see the update notes below: 

- 'No Subtitles' error in optional puzzle 1 -  fixed 
- Mouse inversion in camera mode -   fixed 
- Being able to get power through one of the doors in Sector 14 -   fixed 
- The 'box in face' glitch when going through transition rooms -   fixed 

We are also working hard to fix some other issues you have been experiencing, will we be posting regular updates in the tech support forum here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/499520/discussions/1/

 Thanks for being patient and for all of your continued support! 


-Amy

notes.title: The Turing Test Gets Release Date, Asks Big Questions
notes.notes:
It’s hard not to watch the latest trailer for The Turing Test [official site] and see all the stark parallels between Portal and The Talos Principle. A science fiction first-person game where a robot sidekick guides you through various chambers full of puzzles with themes of transhumanism? Still, despite those on-the-sleeve inspirations, I can’t help but feel drawn in by The Turing Test’s atmosphere and heavy philosophical rumblings. And late last week, a new release trailer revealed that we won’t have to wait too much longer, as The Turing Test is due out on August 30.
